value.rationale: The natural design object is the rank-limited sampling basis in the source truncated infHutch estimator. The theorem solves its exact all-dimension oracle MSE design, provides a unique computable Ritz spectrum via one scalar root, and proves a sharp unexpected failure of principal eigenspace sampling even for rank-deficient matrices. Its relevance is as a calibration/design benchmark, not a claim of practical matrix-free construction.
